dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: Be careful, my friend. Make sure you watch out for falling rocks in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Falling rocks? Aren't we still inside the tribal settlement?

dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: Haha, take a look above you. You'll see what I mean. Anyway, make sure to be on the lookout.

dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're going to the Great Volcano of Tollan?

dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: Haha, I guess I shouldn't be surprised. After all, the Saurian Relics Association and more than a handful of adventurers have been trying to find a way inside that place for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: You strike me as the latter, friend. Am I right? Watch out for sudden eruptions on your expedition, then. You never know what the volcano might spit out right on top of your head!

dialogues.speaker: Koyonki
dialogues.text: You take care of yourself now.
